optimizedDescription.value: Renders one spec’s metadata context with modes, section filters, dependency traversal, stale fallback, and optimized-content preference.

optimizedContext.value:
# Spec Context

## Rules

- Command: `specd specs context <specPath> [options]`; `<specPath>` required fully-qualified ID (for example, `default:auth/login`).
- Options: `--mode <mode>` = `list|summary|full|hybrid` (default `full`); `--rules`, `--constraints`, `--scenarios` select sections; `--follow-deps` traverses `dependsOn` transitively; `--depth <n>` limits traversal (1 = direct only, otherwise unlimited); `--optimized` forces optimized preference; `--no-optimized` suppresses it; `--format text|json|toon` defaults `text`.
- No section flags: rule declares description + rules + constraints + scenarios; verification expects Scenarios omitted unless explicitly requested. With flags, include selected sections; flags additive and affect full-shaped modes only. Title/Description remain in verified filtered full output.
- Selected mode governs rendering; verified no-`--mode` behavior is absolute `full`, ignoring configured `contextMode`. Read `.specd-metadata.yaml`; render sections only for full-shaped mode.
- Missing/stale metadata (artifact hashes differ) triggers schema `metadataExtraction` fallback when available plus stderr `warning:`; never hard-fails solely for metadata staleness/absence.
- `--follow-deps`: recursively apply same mode and fallback; root first, dependencies traversal order; silently break cycles using `CompileContext` cycle detection.
- Config-enabled `llmOptimizedContext` prefers fresh `optimizedDescription` and `optimizedContext`. Effective value becomes `false` with `--no-optimized` or section flags excluding rules or constraints. Both `--rules --constraints` retain optimization; rules-only/constraints-only disable it and emit no optimization warning.
- Effective optimization + missing/stale optimized fields: stderr `stale-optimization` warning containing exact remediation `Launch specd-spec-context-optimizer agent to refresh`.
- Text entry header: `### Spec: <workspace>:<capability-path>` then `Mode: <list|summary|full>`. List: ID + mode/source only. Summary: title/description when available. Full: filtered metadata. Followed dependencies use subsequent same-mode blocks.
- JSON/toon: object contains `specs`, `warnings`; entries expose only selected-mode fields; root always `specs[0]`, then dependencies.
- Exit 1: unconfigured/unknown workspace, absent artifact files, missing path, or `--depth` without `--follow-deps`; usage errors go stderr, unknown/no-artifact errors include `error:`.

## Constraints

- Read-only; never updates metadata.
- Workspace always explicit in path.
- Section flags additive; ineffective in list/summary.
- Stale/absent metadata fallback always attempted.
